$comment: Mdigital Flutter package whitelist/blacklist (Flutter 3.47 stable, Dart 3.13). Same schema and spirit as frontend-pack/rules/libraries.json. Add packages with `flutter pub add`. Anything not listed: ask the user before adding.

allowed.name: flutter (3.47 stable) + dart (3.13)
allowed.reason: Current stable; Impeller default; dot shorthands available since Dart 3.10

allowed.name: Material 3 (material_ui package on 3.47+, or flutter/material.dart)
allowed.use_for: All widgets, themed from Figma tokens
allowed.reason: Default design system with ColorScheme, TextTheme, component themes and ThemeExtension for custom tokens; follow the import style already in the project

allowed.name: cupertino_ui / adaptive constructors (Switch.adaptive, showAdaptiveDialog ...)
allowed.reason: Native feel where it matters without a second design system

allowed.name: flutter_riverpod (3.x) + riverpod_annotation + riverpod_generator
allowed.use_for: DI of services/repositories and view models (Notifier / AsyncNotifier) in the official MVVM structure
allowed.reason: Compile-safe DI, AsyncValue gives loading/error/data for every screen, caching, auto-dispose, a configurable retry policy (we retry only network/timeout/408/429/5xx, max 2), offline/mutation support in 3.0, easy overrides in tests - the closest Flutter match to our TanStack Query discipline

allowed.name: riverpod_lint
allowed.use_for: Provider misuse checks and dart fix migrations
allowed.reason: Catches missing dependencies and wrong ref usage

allowed.name: go_router
allowed.use_for: All routing, deep links, StatefulShellRoute tabs, redirects for auth
allowed.reason: Recommended by the Flutter architecture guide for most apps; maintained by the Flutter team

allowed.name: dio
allowed.use_for: HTTP via one ApiClient in lib/shared/api
allowed.reason: Interceptors (auth, logging), timeouts, CancelToken, typed DioException mapped to our sealed ApiException

allowed.name: freezed + json_serializable + build_runner
allowed.reason: Recommended by the architecture guide (immutable data models); equality and copyWith for free

allowed.name: connectivity_plus
allowed.reason: Standard connectivity signal; still treat request failures as the truth

allowed.name: lucide_icons_flutter
allowed.use_for: Icons when the catalog icon library is Lucide (same set as web and RN)
allowed.reason: Actively maintained Lucide port (LucideIcons.<name>); otherwise use Material Symbols (Icons.*)

allowed.name: cached_network_image
allowed.use_for: Remote images with placeholder and disk cache

allowed.name: flutter_svg
allowed.use_for: SVG icons and illustrations from Figma
allowed.reason: Renders exported SVG with color filters

allowed.name: skeletonizer
allowed.use_for: Loading skeletons that reuse the real widget tree
allowed.reason: Skeleton shape always matches the loaded layout

allowed.name: flutter_localizations + intl (gen-l10n, ARB)
allowed.reason: Official localization flow; on 3.47 GlobalMaterialLocalizations.delegates includes Cupertino and Widgets delegates

allowed.name: sentry_flutter
allowed.use_for: Crash and error reporting, navigation breadcrumbs (SentryNavigatorObserver)
allowed.reason: Captures FlutterError and PlatformDispatcher errors with symbol upload

allowed.name: very_good_analysis
allowed.use_for: Lint rules (strict) with file-size discipline enforced in review
allowed.reason: Stricter superset of flutter_lints (const, public API docs off-switchable, prefer_final); fits our strict TS stance

allowed.name: flutter_test, integration_test, mocktail
allowed.use_for: Widget, golden, accessibility-guideline and integration tests; fakes for repositories
allowed.reason: SDK tools; mocktail needs no codegen; the guide recommends fakes

conditional.name: flutter_bloc / bloc
conditional.when: Existing project already on Bloc, or the client mandates it
conditional.reason: Solid and explicit (events -> states) but more boilerplate; do not mix with Riverpod in one app

conditional.name: provider + ChangeNotifier view models
conditional.when: Existing project following the official Compass-app style, or a very small app
conditional.reason: Exactly what the Flutter architecture guide shows; fewer features for caching and async states

conditional.name: flutter_hooks + hooks_riverpod
conditional.when: Team prefers hooks for controllers (TextEditingController, AnimationController) lifecycles
conditional.reason: Less StatefulWidget boilerplate; optional, project-wide decision

conditional.name: retrofit
conditional.when: Large REST surface where generated clients save real code
conditional.reason: On top of dio; still mapped to ApiException

conditional.name: openapi-generator (dart-dio)
conditional.reason: Generated models and clients; keep repositories as our boundary

conditional.name: drift
conditional.when: Offline-first features with relational local data
conditional.reason: Type-safe SQLite; a cache is not a database

conditional.name: flutter_animate
conditional.when: Rich choreographed entrance animations from the design
conditional.reason: Declarative effects; implicit animations cover most cases

conditional.name: google_fonts
conditional.when: Prototypes only, with runtime fetching disabled and fonts bundled
conditional.reason: Production apps bundle fonts in assets

conditional.name: alchemist
conditional.when: Many golden tests across themes and platforms
conditional.reason: Golden test helpers with CI-stable rendering

conditional.name: auto_route
conditional.reason: Fine, but one router per app and go_router for new work

conditional.name: get_it
conditional.when: Existing project using it for DI
conditional.reason: Riverpod providers do DI in new code

forbidden.name: get (GetX)
forbidden.reason: Global magic state, routing and DI in one package; hard to test, fights the architecture guide

forbidden.name: Server data in setState / StatefulWidget fields, FutureBuilder creating the future in build()
forbidden.reason: Refetches on every rebuild, no cache, no retry, no shared state

forbidden.name: Redux, MobX, StateNotifier/StateProvider (legacy Riverpod API) in new code
package:http or dio called directly from widgets or view models
flutter_screenutil, sizer and other screen-scaling packages
forbidden.reason: Scale everything by device width, break text scaling and tablets

forbidden.name: Color(0x...), Colors.*, raw TextStyle(fontSize:), raw EdgeInsets numbers in feature code
forbidden.reason: Breaks dark mode and token sync

forbidden.name: Helper methods returning widgets (_buildHeader())
forbidden.instead: Separate widget classes with const constructors
forbidden.reason: No own element or rebuild boundary; hides size; Flutter performance guidance prefers widgets

forbidden.name: useMaterial3: false, third-party design kits (velocity_x, getwidget, flutter_neumorphic)
fluttertoast, another_flushbar
forbidden.reason: Platform channels for a solved problem; inconsistent a11y

forbidden.name: Platform.isIOS / device-type checks for layout, portrait lock by default
forbidden.instead: Window size breakpoints (600 / 840); adaptive constructors for behaviour
forbidden.reason: Flutter adaptive guidance: decide by window size, never lock orientation

forbidden.name: Navigator.pushNamed / onGenerateRoute in new code
forbidden.reason: No deep-link or web URL story
